cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook claude PermissionRequest; fi
cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook claude PostToolBatch; fi
cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook claude Stop; fi
cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook claude SessionStart; fi
cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook claude SessionEnd; fi
